description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription ECS instances, including whether auto-renewal is enabled and the renewal period
description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台或多台包年包月ECS实例的自动续费属性，包括是否开启自动续费、续费周期等信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-instance-auto-renew-attribute --instance-id i-bp18x3z4hc7bixhx0000,i-bp1g6zv0ce8oghu70000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --renewal-status AutoRenewal --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can specify up to 100 subscription instance IDs at a time. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).

You must specify at least one of the InstanceId and RenewalStatus parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。支持最多100台包年包月实例批量查询，多个实例ID以半角逗号分隔。

`InstanceId`与`RenewalStatus`参数至少需要填写一个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal status of ECS instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.

Normal: Auto-renewal is disabled.

NotRenewal: ECS instance will not be renewed. The system no longer sends expiration reminders but sends only a non-renewal reminder three days before ECS instance expires. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52843.html to change the renewal status of an instance from NotRenewal to `Normal`, and then manually renew ECS instance or enable auto-renewal for ECS instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的自动续费状态。取值范围：

AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

Normal：取消自动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的ECS实例可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52843.html更改成待续费（0）后，再自行续费或设置为自动续费
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Unit: entries.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页展示响应信息时设置的每页行数，单位：行。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询接口返回资源信息列表的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances returned
